note: Owner Question rulings. apply-questions-final.mjs merges these after the certified set is assembled, so a re-derive cannot erase them. Same overlay pattern as entities/themes/emphasis/directives. A ruling carrying "was":"Claim" ALSO withdraws that occurrence from Claims — apply-claims.mjs reads THIS SAME FILE, so one record moves the line and the two sections cannot drift apart. A ruling carrying "was":"Evidence" leaves the Evidence record standing: Evidence is provenance (this text is quoted source material), not a display category, and it does not paint in the drop body.
why: The question detector anchors on a line ENDING in '?'. A question wrapped in parentheses ends in '?)' and never matched — #524's "(Why don't we say his name?)" sat in Context instead. 50 lines corpus-wide have that shape; only the ones the owner rules are added. — SECOND RULING SET, 2026-08-19: an archive-wide scan for units ending in "?" that are certified in some other section found 37 real cases (54 raw, less 17 links whose URL merely ends in "?"). The owner ruled the QUOTED-SPEECH family: a question Q reproduces inside quotation marks is still a question. Four candidates were deliberately NOT ruled and stay as they are — #2971 is a pasted dictionary block, and three #2776 lines each carry SEVERAL quoted questions in one unit, which is a segmentation problem to fix at the boundary rather than a misfiling to reclassify.
